# Self score then reveal

`customer_support.pb.quality_assurance.self_score_then_reveal` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Have the agent score their own interaction against the same rubric before the reviewer's score is shown. Discuss the gap, not the score.

The gap separates a skill problem from a standard problem. An agent who scores themselves the same as the reviewer and still did it wrong needs training; an agent who scores themselves far higher never understood the standard, which is a rubric or onboarding finding rather than a performance one.
